name: revenue-range-scans
description: Measure numeric range predicates and selective sums

queries.name: midrange-events
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE amount >= 2500 AND amount < 7500

queries.name: midrange-revenue
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM events WHERE amount >= 2500 AND amount < 7500

queries.name: low-or-high-revenue
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM events WHERE amount < 2500 OR amount >= 7500
